```{r}
#installing packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(googlesheets4)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
```

```{r}
#import data 
koa_master = range_read(('https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1T3TNqTVI4zFGS-up--IIOSRfn0fsBx5Dj7zEeDEAiCQ/edit?gid=771488326#gid=771488326'), sheet= 4)  %>%
 mutate(
    across(
      c(days_since_outplanting, 
        kelp_on_ARKEV, 
        starts_with("stipe_length_")
        ), ~ as.numeric(na_if(as.character(.), "ND"))
    )
  )

str(koa_master)
```

#KELP ON ARKEV FOR BOTH SITES
```{r}
koa_both_sites <- koa_master %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    site %in% c("noyo", "big river"),
    !is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV),
    !is.na(date),
    !is.na(site),
    !is.na(ARKEV_type),
    !is.na(ARKEV_unit)
  ) %>%
  distinct(date, site, ARKEV_unit, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    plot = str_extract(ARKEV_unit, "\\d+"),
    ARKEV_type = fct_relevel(
      ARKEV_type,
      "PVC",
      "WOOD"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Total kelp across ARKEVs within each site/date
  group_by(site, date) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  
  # Summary statistics within each site/date/ARKEV type
  group_by(site, date, ARKEV_type) %>%
  mutate(
    total_type = sum(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

```


```{r}
ggplot(koa_both_sites,
       aes(x = date, y = mean, color = site, linetype = ARKEV_type, group = interaction(site, ARKEV_type))) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 1.5) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "PVC" = "solid",
      "WOOD" = "dashed")) +
   scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "big river" = "#E69F00", 
      "noyo" = "#0072B2"        
      )) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Spliced Sporophytes per ARKEV",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total # Spliced Individuals",
    color = "Site",
    linetype = "ARKEV Type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```
#survivorship analyses by ARKEV type among sites
#noyo
```{r}
kelp_noyo <- koa_both_sites %>%
  filter(site == "noyo")

kelp_survival_noyo <- kelp_noyo %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    ),
    date = factor(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV),
    !is.na(ARKEV_unit),
    !is.na(ARKEV_type)
  ) 
  
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

kelp_model_noyo <- lmer(
  kelp_on_ARKEV ~ ARKEV_type * date + (1 | ARKEV_unit),
  data = kelp_survival_noyo,
  REML = TRUE
)

anova(kelp_model_noyo)
emmeans(kelp_model_noyo, pairwise ~ ARKEV_type | date)
```

```{r}
plot(kelp_model_noyo)
qqnorm(residuals(kelp_model_noyo))
qqline(residuals(kelp_model_noyo))
```


```{r}
#number of ARKEVs that retain kelp by type
baseline_noyo <- kelp_noyo %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV)) %>%
  arrange(ARKEV_unit, date) %>%
  group_by(ARKEV_unit) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    ARKEV_unit,
    baseline_date = date,
    baseline_kelp = kelp_on_ARKEV
  )

kelp_survival_noyo <- kelp_noyo %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(
      paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV),
    !is.na(ARKEV_unit),
    !is.na(ARKEV_type)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    baseline_noyo,
    by = "ARKEV_unit"
  )
```

```{r}
ARKEV_survival_noyo <- kelp_survival_noyo %>%
  arrange(ARKEV_unit, date) %>%
  group_by(ARKEV_unit) %>%
  mutate(
    kelp_lost = as.integer(
      baseline_kelp > 0 &
      cumsum(kelp_on_ARKEV == 0) > 0
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ARKEV_survival_noyo %>%
  filter(date == baseline_date) %>%
  select(
    ARKEV_unit,
    ARKEV_type,
    baseline_date,
    baseline_kelp,
    kelp_on_ARKEV
  )

ARKEV_survival_noyo %>%
  filter(date == baseline_date) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ARKEV = n(),
    n_mismatch = sum(baseline_kelp != kelp_on_ARKEV)
  )

```

```{r}
kelp_survival_noyo <- kelp_survival_noyo %>%
  mutate(
    kelp_lost = ifelse(
      baseline_kelp > 0 & kelp_on_ARKEV == 0, 1, 0))

kelp_survival_noyo_summary <- kelp_survival_noyo %>%
  group_by(date, ARKEV_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ARKEV = n(),
    n_lost = sum(kelp_lost),
    n_retained = sum(kelp_lost == 0),
    percent_lost = 100 * n_lost / n_ARKEV,
    percent_retained = 100 * n_retained / n_ARKEV,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kelp_survival_noyo_summary
```

```{r}
survival_tests_noyo <- kelp_survival_noyo %>%
  filter(date > as.Date("2026-04-18")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = fisher.test(
      table(ARKEV_type, kelp_lost)
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")
  )

survival_tests_noyo
```

#Both sites
```{r}
#linear model
kelp_site_analysis <- koa_master %>%
  filter(site %in% c("noyo", "big river")) %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(site),
    ARKEV_type = factor(ARKEV_type),
    ARKEV_unit = factor(ARKEV_unit)
  )

kelp_model_sites <- lmer(
  kelp_on_ARKEV ~ site * days_since_outplanting + ARKEV_type + (1 | ARKEV_unit), data = kelp_site_analysis, REML = FALSE)

anova(kelp_model_sites)
```

```{r}
# Quadratic time model
kelp_model_sites_quad <- lmer(
  kelp_on_ARKEV ~ site * (days_since_outplanting + I(days_since_outplanting^2)) + ARKEV_type + (1 | ARKEV_unit),
  data = kelp_site_analysis,
  REML = FALSE
)

# Compare models
anova(kelp_model_sites, kelp_model_sites_quad)

# Compare AIC
AIC(kelp_model_sites, kelp_model_sites_quad)
```

```{r}
anova(kelp_model_sites_quad)
```

```{r}
site_means <- kelp_site_analysis %>%
  group_by(site, days_since_outplanting) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV)),
    mean_kelp = mean(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")


days_seq <- seq(
  min(kelp_site_analysis$days_since_outplanting, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(kelp_site_analysis$days_since_outplanting, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200
)

pred <- emmeans(
  kelp_model_sites_quad,
  ~ site * days_since_outplanting,
  at = list(days_since_outplanting = days_seq)
)

pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred)


site_means <- kelp_site_analysis %>%
  group_by(site, days_since_outplanting) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_kelp = mean(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


```

```{r}
site_colors <- c(
```

```{r}
site_means <- kelp_site_analysis %>%
  group_by(site, days_since_outplanting) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_kelp = mean(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(kelp_on_ARKEV, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(kelp_on_ARKEV))),
    .groups = "drop"  )

noyo_data <- site_means %>%
  filter(site == "noyo")

big_river_data <- site_means %>%
  filter(site == "big river")

noyo_exp <- nls(mean_kelp ~ a * exp(-b * days_since_outplanting) + c, data = noyo_data, start = list(a = 6, b = 0.01, c = 2))

big_river_exp <- nls(mean_kelp ~ a * exp(-b * days_since_outplanting) + c,data = big_river_data,start = list(a = 8, b = 0.03, c = 1.5))

pred_days <- seq(
  0,
  max(kelp_site_analysis$days_since_outplanting, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 200)

noyo_pred <- data.frame(days_since_outplanting = pred_days, site = "noyo")

noyo_pred$fit <- predict( noyo_exp, newdata = noyo_pred)

big_river_pred <- data.frame(days_since_outplanting = pred_days, site = "big river")

big_river_pred$fit <- predict(big_river_exp, newdata = big_river_pred)

pred_df <- bind_rows(noyo_pred, big_river_pred)
```

```{r}
site_colors <- c("noyo" = "#0072B2","big river" = "#E69F00")

ggplot() + geom_line(data = pred_df,aes(x = days_since_outplanting, y = fit,color = site),linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = site_means, aes(x = days_since_outplanting, y = mean_kelp, color = site), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = site_means,aes(x = days_since_outplanting, ymin = mean_kelp - se,ymax = mean_kelp + se,color = site),width = 2,linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = site_colors,
    labels = c(
      "noyo" = "Noyo",
      "big river" = "Big River")) +
  labs(
    title = "Kelp abundance per ARKEV through time since outplanting",
    subtitle = "Observed means ± SE with fitted decay trajectories",
    x = "Days Since Outplanting",
    y = "Kelp per ARKEV",
    color = "Site") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, face = "italic"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

#STIPE LENGTH DATA FOR BOTH SITES
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

stipe_arkev <- koa_master %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-"), format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  filter(
    site %in% c("noyo", "big river")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("stipe_length_"),
    names_to = "stipe_number",
    values_to = "stipe_length"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(stipe_length)) %>%
  
  # Calculate the average of the measured stipes
  # for each individual ARKEV
  group_by(site, date, days_since_outplanting, ARKEV_unit, ARKEV_type) %>%
  summarise(
    arkev_mean_length = mean(stipe_length),
    n_stipes = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stipe_data <- stipe_arkev %>%
  group_by(site, date, ARKEV_type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_length_type = mean(arkev_mean_length),
    se_type = sd(arkev_mean_length) / sqrt(n()),
    max_type = max(arkev_mean_length),
    n_arkev = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(stipe_data,aes(x = date, y = avg_length_type, color = site, linetype = ARKEV_type, group = interaction(site, ARKEV_type))) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = avg_length_type - se_type,
      ymax = avg_length_type + se_type),
    width = 1.5) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "PVC" = "solid",
      "WOOD" = "dashed")) +
   scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "big river" = "#E69F00", 
      "noyo" = "#0072B2"        
      )) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Stipe Length by ARKEV Type",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Average Stipe Length (cm)",
    color = "Site",
    linetype = "ARKEV Type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

#test for differences in stipe length among type within each site 
```{r}
stipe_model_data <- stipe_arkev %>%
  mutate(
    ARKEV_type = factor(ARKEV_type),
    ARKEV_unit = factor(ARKEV_unit),
    date = factor(date)
  )
```

#noyo
```{r}
stipe_noyo <- stipe_model_data %>%
  filter(site == "noyo")

stipe_model_noyo <- lmer(
  arkev_mean_length ~ ARKEV_type + date + (1 | ARKEV_unit),
  data = stipe_noyo
)

anova(stipe_model_noyo)

emmeans(stipe_model_noyo, pairwise ~ ARKEV_type)
emmeans(stipe_model_noyo, pairwise ~ date)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(
  fitted(stipe_model_noyo),
  resid(stipe_model_noyo),
  xlab = "Fitted values",
  ylab = "Residuals",
  main = "Residuals vs Fitted"
)

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

qqnorm(
  resid(stipe_model_noyo),
  main = "Normal Q-Q Plot"
)

qqline(resid(stipe_model_noyo))
```

```{r}
library(nlme)

stipe_model_noyo_var <- lme(
  arkev_mean_length ~ ARKEV_type + date,
  random = ~1 | ARKEV_unit,
  weights = varIdent(form = ~1 | ARKEV_type),
  data = stipe_noyo,
  method = "REML")

anova(stipe_model_noyo_var)

emmeans(stipe_model_noyo_var, pairwise ~ date)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(
  fitted(stipe_model_noyo_var),
  resid(stipe_model_noyo_var, type = "normalized"),
  xlab = "Fitted values",
  ylab = "Normalized residuals",
  main = "Residuals vs Fitted"
)

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

qqnorm(
  resid(stipe_model_noyo_var, type = "normalized"),
  main = "Normal Q-Q Plot"
)

qqline(resid(stipe_model_noyo_var, type = "normalized"))
```

```{r}
AIC(stipe_model_noyo, stipe_model_noyo_var)
```

##Use simpler model since AIC are nearly the same and they are essentially the same fit

#stipe growth rate
```{r}
stipe_growth <- stipe_arkev %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  arrange(site, ARKEV_unit, date, days_since_outplanting) %>%
  group_by(site, ARKEV_unit) %>%
  mutate(previous_length = lag(arkev_mean_length), previous_date = lag(date), days_between = as.numeric(date - previous_date), growth_cm = arkev_mean_length - previous_length, growth_rate_cm_day = growth_cm / days_between
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(growth_rate_cm_day))

stipe_growth %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean_growth_rate = mean(growth_rate_cm_day, na.rm = TRUE), se = sd(growth_rate_cm_day, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
growth_model <- lmer(
  growth_rate_cm_day ~ site + (1 | ARKEV_unit),
  data = stipe_growth,
  REML = TRUE
)

anova(growth_model)

emmeans(growth_model, pairwise ~ site)
```
```{r}
growth_model_time <- lmer(
  growth_rate_cm_day ~ site * days_since_outplanting +
    (1 | ARKEV_unit),
  data = stipe_growth,
  REML = TRUE
)

anova(growth_model_time)

emmeans(growth_model_time, pairwise ~ site | days_since_outplanting)
```

```{r}
stipe_growth_day <- stipe_arkev %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    site = factor(site),
    ARKEV_unit = factor(ARKEV_unit)
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, ARKEV_unit, date) %>%
  group_by(site, ARKEV_unit) %>%
  mutate(
    previous_length = lag(arkev_mean_length),
    previous_date = lag(date),
    previous_days = lag(days_since_outplanting),

    days_between =
      days_since_outplanting - previous_days,

    growth_cm =
      arkev_mean_length - previous_length,

    growth_rate_cm_day =
      growth_cm / days_between,

    days_since_outplanting_midpoint =
      (previous_days + days_since_outplanting) / 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(growth_rate_cm_day),
    !is.na(days_since_outplanting_midpoint),
    days_between > 0
  )
```

```{r}
growth_model_midpoint <- lmer(
  growth_rate_cm_day ~
    site * days_since_outplanting_midpoint +
    (1 | site:ARKEV_unit),
  data = stipe_growth_day,
  REML = TRUE
)

anova(growth_model_midpoint)

growth_trends <- emtrends(
  growth_model_midpoint,
  ~ site,
  var = "days_since_outplanting_midpoint"
)

growth_trends

pairs(growth_trends, adjust = "tukey")
```
```{r}
stipe_growth_day %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_units = n_distinct(ARKEV_unit),
    n_timepoints = n_distinct(days_since_outplanting_midpoint),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
growth_means_midpoint <- stipe_growth_day %>%
  group_by(
    site,
    days_since_outplanting_midpoint
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_growth =
      mean(growth_rate_cm_day, na.rm = TRUE),

    se =
      sd(growth_rate_cm_day, na.rm = TRUE) /
      sqrt(sum(!is.na(growth_rate_cm_day))),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

growth_pred <- emmeans(
  growth_model_midpoint,
  ~ site | days_since_outplanting_midpoint,
  at = list(
    days_since_outplanting_midpoint = seq(
      min(stipe_growth_day$days_since_outplanting_midpoint, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(stipe_growth_day$days_since_outplanting_midpoint, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 200
    )
  )
) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
ggplot() +geom_ribbon(data = growth_pred, aes(x = days_since_outplanting_midpoint,ymin = lower.CL,ymax = upper.CL, fill = site), alpha = 0.20,color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = growth_pred,  aes(x = days_since_outplanting_midpoint, y = emmean, color = site),linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = growth_means_midpoint,aes(x = days_since_outplanting_midpoint,y = mean_growth,color = site),size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = growth_means_midpoint, aes(x = days_since_outplanting_midpoint,ymin = mean_growth - se,ymax = mean_growth + se,color = site),width = 2,linewidth = 0.8) +
```

```{r}
stipe_growth_date <- stipe_arkev %>%
  mutate(
    site = as.character(site),
    ARKEV_unit = as.character(ARKEV_unit),
    date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  arrange(site, ARKEV_unit, date) %>%
  group_by(site, ARKEV_unit) %>%
  mutate(
    next_date = lead(date),
    next_mean_length = lead(arkev_mean_length),
    growth_rate = (next_mean_length - arkev_mean_length) / as.numeric(next_date - date),
    midpoint_date = date +(next_date - date) / 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(growth_rate),
    !is.na(midpoint_date))
```

```{r}
stipe_growth_summary_date <- stipe_growth_date %>%
  group_by(site, midpoint_date) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_growth = mean(growth_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(growth_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop")

stipe_growth_model_date <- lmer(
  growth_rate ~ site * midpoint_date + (1 | ARKEV_unit),
  data = stipe_growth_date,
  REML = TRUE)

anova(stipe_growth_model_date)
```

```{r}
pred_dates <- seq(
  min(stipe_growth_date$midpoint_date),
  max(stipe_growth_date$midpoint_date),
  length.out = 200
)

pred_data <- expand.grid(
  midpoint_date = pred_dates,
  site = unique(stipe_growth_date$site)
)

pred_data$site <- as.character(pred_data$site)

pred <- predict(
  stipe_growth_model_date,
  newdata = pred_data,
  re.form = NA,
  se.fit = TRUE
)

pred_data$fit <- pred$fit
pred_data$lower <- pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit
pred_data$upper <- pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit
```

```{r}
ggplot() +  geom_ribbon(data = pred_data, aes(x = midpoint_date, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = site), alpha = 0.20, color = NA
  ) +
```
